g.text: Cut trace to disconnect CHG LED.
IO0: Avoid device connections. Can be used a stat LED.
IO5: Has builtin pullup at POR.
ADC2 is unavailable when WiFi is enabled.
Use boot control pins with caution: 0, 2, 5, 12, 15
V_USB - 6V MAX V_BATT - Single Cell (4.2V MAX)
IO2: Avoid external pullups - will cause bootloader fail.
If DTR is LOW, toggling RTS from HIGH to LOW resets to run mode. If RTS is HIGH, toggling DTR from LOW to HIGH resets to bootloader.
Charge current: I_CHG = 1000 / R_PROG R_PROG=2k : I_CHG=500mA
Cut trace to disconnect PWR LED.
IO12: Avoid external pullups - will cause bootloader fail.
IO15: Has builtin pullup at POR.
Cut trace to disconnect SHLD from GND.
